featured_reviews.name: Divyansh Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text: My experience at VMKB was great. The hostel management, the staff, environment and facilities are really good. The annual cultural fest and sports fest creates holistic development of students. Additionally the rooms and facilities provided makes it a proper choice for a student.

featured_reviews.name: Dr Rohit Gattewar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very pleasant stay at this hostel. The hostel is well-maintained, clean, and provides a comfortable living environment. The staff is extremely cooperative, friendly, and always ready to help whenever needed.

A special mention to Vishal Sir for his excellent management and support. He ensures that everything runs smoothly and is always approachable for any concerns or assistance. His professionalism and dedication make a big difference in the overall experience.

The facilities are well managed, cleanliness is maintained consistently, and the atmosphere is welcoming. I would highly recommend this hostel to anyone looking for a comfortable and hassle-free stay.

featured_reviews.name: Darshil Marathe
featured_reviews.review_text: Stayed here during my Graduation Period. Facilities provided are great like air conditioned gym and computer rooms to study. The garden/plantation area is full of greenery. The staff is friendly and really helpful. The best part is you get to meet people from various education streams and connect and learn from them. The management holds Festival events and the annual Pinnacle Event and annual Sports Competion which is full of enthusiasm!!

featured_reviews.name: Sukant Thombare
featured_reviews.review_text:
My experience at VMKB Hostel, Matunga, has been positive overall. The hostel is mainly designed for students, so the environment is calm and study-friendly. The biggest benefit is the location — Matunga has excellent connectivity, and daily essentials, gyms, libraries, and railway stations are all within walking distance.
Rooms are simple and functional; nothing fancy, but enough for a student. Cleanliness is decent, though it improves a lot if the roommates maintain the space. Staff members are strict about timings and discipline, which helps maintain safety inside the premises.

featured_reviews.name: prabhu puttur
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our experience at the hostel has been very positive. The management is responsive and genuinely cares about students’ comfort and well-being. Hygiene is maintained and the environment is safe and disciplined.

A great place for students to focus on their studies while feeling at home.... ☺

featured_reviews.name: Pallavi
featured_reviews.review_text: Visited VMKB Boys hostel, Matunga while arranging accommodation for my relative.  The environment was positive, hygienic and students friendly. Office staff and other members are cooperative and overall facilities are excellent. Nice atmosphere for students to focus on studies.

featured_reviews.name: Aditya Lakhan
featured_reviews.review_text: VMKB Boys Hostel is a very nice and comfortable stay for students studying in Mumbai also this is located in a peaceful environment, It offers many facilities for students. The staff is also supportive, making students feel comfortable like home.

featured_reviews.name: Jeet Adani
featured_reviews.review_text: This is the place where my hostel life had began. From 2018-21, each day was special and grateful for the management of VMKB hostel to provide us with all facilities to make our college life fun. VMKB hostel is best for a reason, there are student let committees of for various hostel management activities which makes it a happy place to live. The staff is supportive and caring. All festivals are celebrated with same zeal and enthusiasm. Annual hostel day events are special. The seniors or ex-students are available too for any support required. Overall a wholesome place to start your college life in Mumbai. Thank you for all the love and care, VMKB hostel!

This is the biggest fraud school. The school has completely betrayed the trust of parents. They collected fees from parents and then, just before reopening in June 2026, suddenly decided to shift the school to another location due to ongoing construction issues and they don't have permission to run the school.

This is not the first time. The same thing happened in 2022–23. More than 1,300 students and their families are suffering because of the school's mismanagement and false assurances.

The management has shown complete disregard for the future, education, and safety of children. Parents have been kept in the dark and forced to accept decisions without consultation or transparency.

I strongly advise parents to think carefully before taking admission in Orchid. No parent should have to face this kind of uncertainty and stress regarding their child's education.

The future of children is not a business experiment. Parents deserve honesty, accountability, and respect.

featured_reviews.name: Deepika Jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am extremely pleased with my decision to enroll my child at Kaveri Kids International School. The school offers a well-equipped and nurturing environment that encourages children to learn with enthusiasm—my child looks forward to attending school every day without hesitation.

The teaching as well as non-teaching staff are highly professional, approachable, and dedicated to ensuring a positive and safe experience for the children. What stands out is the school’s holistic approach—while maintaining strong academic standards, equal emphasis is placed on overall personality development, creativity, and essential life skills.

The structured curriculum, engaging activities, and child-centric approach truly make it a great foundation for early learning. I would highly recommend the school to parents seeking a balanced and enriching educational experience for their children.

Wishing the school continued growth and success.

featured_reviews.review_text:
The teachers and staff are incredibly caring, attentive, and create such a warm and nurturing environment for the kids. You can truly see their dedication in the way they handle each child with patience and love.
